intent.notes: Lunch-break antagonist strength at a weights gym: bench press 4x6, a ring push-up that follows your bodyweight ladder, triceps and a biceps curl, all at RIR 1-2 (one or two clean reps left in the tank), plus one rotating core exercise. Loads come from your working loads and move with your feedback. About 35 min. Balances the pull-dominant climbing pattern without touching the fingers. Biceps are elbow-flexor work: keep them away from the 24 h before a heavy pulling session. In a deload week drop one set per exercise and stop at RIR 3.

modules.notes: Short pulse raise before pressing. Do one or two light ramp-up sets of the bench press before the first working set.
Horizontal press for the chest: bench press with free weights, the same movement every time so the load can progress from feedback. Without weights it falls back to another push movement.

prescription_overrides.notes: Strength dose: 4 x 6 at RIR 1-2 with a 3 s lowering phase. If every set felt like RIR 3 or more, log the session as easy and the next load goes up.

modules.notes: Bodyweight horizontal push on the rings. For a tested athlete it follows the push ladder (ring push-up, then ring push-up with the rings turned out) with the sets and reps of the current level; otherwise a ring push-up at its default dose.

prescription_overrides.notes: Stop each set at RIR 1-2, body rigid as a plank, 2 s pause at the top. When the ladder sets the dose, follow its sets and reps.

modules.notes: Triceps isolation on the cable machine (pushdown). The session requires a cable machine, so it is only offered where this block is real triceps work.

prescription_overrides.notes: 3 x 10 at RIR 1-2, elbows pinned to your sides. If every set felt like RIR 3 or more, log it as easy and the load goes up.

modules.notes: Elbow flexion for the biceps: a dumbbell curl, the same movement every time so the load can progress from feedback (never a weighted pull-up or chin-up).

prescription_overrides.notes: 3 x 8 at RIR 1-2, 3 s lowering phase, no swing. If every set felt like RIR 3 or more, log it as easy and the load goes up.

modules.notes: One floor or cable core exercise, rotated week by week (tested athletes alternate the ab-wheel rollout, at the level of its bodyweight ladder, and the cable woodchop). No hanging and no front lever here: this lunch can sit on the same day as a limit evening session.
